name: zfmv_action_image_destructor
description: zFMV_ActionImage::Destructor restores the action-image vtable, calls End, frees imagePath when present, clears imagePath, and leaves the object on the base action vtable.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV image action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4632a0 validates the MSVC thiscall destructor with an SEH frame: install the action-image vtable, call zFMV_ActionImage::End, free non-null imagePath, clear imagePath to null, install g_zFMV_ActionBase_Vtable, and return without a value.
The native smoke verifies release-and-clear image behavior through End, imagePath free-and-clear behavior, and the final base vtable identity.
